Business Plan

We want to start a business selling clothes. I have always loved fashion and I think it will do very well because everyone wears clothes. People in my village will definitely buy from me and I will make a lot of money.

I need money to buy things for the shop. I will pay it back when the business is going. I am hard working and I know how to talk to customers. I plan to open soon.

The business will be called Fashion Star.
